title: A larger render size must stay inside the renderer's canvas limit
rule: When the UI raises the size or text length it asks render_preview for, multiply it out: characters × em × CSS px × device scale must stay under MAX_SIDE_PX (8,192) in crates/fm-core/src/preview.rs. Past that the renderer clips silently and reports no error. Test the requested size at devicePixelRatio 2, not only at 1.
rationale: E41.1 (#447): thumbnails moved from 36 px to 120 px with a 64-character guard, so 40 CJK characters at DPR 2 lost their end with the card state still ready.
